Unmodified dist/pdf-lib.esm.min.js (source-map comment removed). Vendored because this site has no npm build step.
Used by ../billing-pdf.js to attach PDF copies of quotations, invoices, receipts and engagement letters.

Unmodified src/ folder in postal-mime/. Reads incoming email (MIME) for the dashboard mailbox (../mail.js).
